name: run
text: A person runs forward at a fast steady pace in a straight line, alternating long strides with a clear airborne phase between footfalls. Elbows bent and arms pumping opposite the legs, torso leaning slightly forward. Continue running for the whole clip without slowing, stopping or turning.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 持续跑步，前倾上身、屈肘对侧摆臂和离地换步；试片稳定段约3.05米/秒，高于已有jog约2.42米/秒，非简单加速已有慢跑。
